title: PlayerCore: First Steps
summary: Set a dependable home and learn the travel messages before taking risks.

blocks.title: Set Shelter First
blocks.body: Use the home command at a safe base, then list homes to confirm the name and limit. A named home is only useful if you can recognize it later.

blocks.title: Test A Return
blocks.body: Travel a short distance, return home, and note whether the server stores a back location. Keep the first test close to shelter.

blocks.title: Learn The Messages
blocks.body: Cooldowns, disabled commands, unsafe destinations, and dimension blocks all have different messages. Read them before assuming the command failed randomly.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
